translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Paulo Eŋe Anutu Wane Ŋei Kine Kine Loutne Okane Ari More Kineine Ma Qelaŋange
Anuturop urata qeturage weku mamaine, ŋedo naŋ ŋingu more ramaine, yemo ŋine Anutu wano ŋine dan gunut makoi, ea qeligeu wele midaine mi okaniake.
Ea wane Anutu wane Papiaŋo ramaike,

content.text: “Na naso maine ŋibongole, eao detŋungole, pakiso ŋibu ŋibu kaiwe naso yewao qesiŋ ŋungole.” Kau, iwa mo Anutuŋo maine rake, ea wane naso, eŋane dangunut maikei, so iwa mo mena menaŋ ea wane kaiwe naso maine.

content: Ŋene ŋei eŋe urata mamaze mi qaisik kaikei, ea wane numa mi leŋon okanmaine.

Ŋene Anutu wane urata ŋei gemaine, ea wane kine ma qelaŋane more kine kine iwa yale okane ari okanmaine. Wikile koto wet pesek ge okanmaine, ŋetne ŋetne kutno ge okanmaine, matali qetali ŋebuwi ea wane kutno ge okanmaine, kaet kotino ge okanmaine.
Kumunamŋo ŋengu okanmami, mulapko biraŋon okanmami, ŋaba keuo ge okanmaine, urata togole ma more wikile det okanmaine, kulu mi papa ruo wisika ge okanmaine, paki ŋarawane seuk okanmaine.

Sot midaine ge okanmaine, wet dereret korop ge okanmaine, wet peseko ge okanmaine, kima maulukon okanmaine, Asu Koboboinerop ge okanmaine, paki ŋene Anutu wane urata ŋei gemaine ea wane kine ŋenane wet maep wele ea sikanon okanmaine.
Don wele ra okanmaine, so Anutu wane zonomgo ge okanmaine. Ŋene koboboine eaŋo miti wane tebe zaun leleki wongo so kanao weneŋ ma ge okanmaine.
Ewe kito kito so ewe mabaik koto ge okanmaine, don maine so don borikinane kotino ge okanmaine. Ŋene isi ŋei ŋedorau, ŋene don welekatne ra okanmaine.
Kineze mi detkamami, ŋo siluŋ kisize koropŋo det okanami, seu seune, ŋo siluŋ wisikae ge okanmaine, ŋengu matali ŋonmami, ŋo siluŋ mi seuk okanmaine.
Wet borik okanŋongoi, ŋo siluŋ naso baŋem wet peseko ge okanmaine, aboŋze midaine gemaine, ŋo siluŋ ŋei loutne qesiŋon okanmaine, ŋene yeye kine kineze midaine, ŋo siluŋ morian gorop ge okanmaine.
O Korinti ŋei, wetze ŋinaneka zok okoraki aŋaze ewekmaike.
Ŋenane wetzeŋo togogole ŋine luk ŋunmaine, ŋo ŋinane wet maepŋineŋo yemo nigatneka pamaike.
Ea wane dokone na ŋidanbe, ŋine turuŋine mainge more ŋine korop wetŋine suaine motpi ŋenano payake.
Qelaŋ Tanik Manik Ea Wane Girem Don
Qelaŋ ŋei eŋe wauŋemene tewekeu, ŋine eŋe misuk qesiŋone more tewekkei. Maine so borikine ere daleo kima okanikeik? Me qelaŋan so panaman ere daleo weku takot nagukeik?
Me Kristo so ŋei borikine ere daleo wet weku okangeik? Me doku tau tau so qelaŋ eŋe daleo qeturaŋgei?
Me Anutu wane Bakom Urum so lopio ere daleo tako rakot okangeik? Detmami, Anutu gegeinerop eŋane urum yemo ŋene. Anutu oŋom iwa yale rake,

content.text: “Na baŋ eŋane keuo gekale, so ari sari okangale, so na baŋ eŋane Anutu okangale, eso eŋe baŋ naŋane ŋei ŋerep okane gekei.”
“Ŋine eŋe qeliŋonikei, pakiso eŋe biraone toitoine gekei. So kine kine diinerop, ea mane mi uakaikei, eso na baŋ ŋine ŋibukale.
Paki na baŋ ŋinane Magaŋine okanikale, eso ŋine baŋ naŋane gipolekopne so boraso kopne okanikei, Waom Togogoleŋo don yale ramaike.”
